David Professor of Business Administration Donald K. David Professor of Business Administration Read more Youngme Moon is the Donald K. David Professor of Business at Harvard Business School. Professor Moon's research sits at the intersection of brand strategy and culture, with a particular focus on the emergent AI economy. She is the author of the bestselling book, Different , and she has published and sold more than two million case studies on companies ranging from Starbucks to IKEA to Uber.
